## Line 89

```plato

// The region between a chord and the arc it subtends (a sector minus its inner
// triangle); always convex. Sweep gives the arc's angular interval on the circle.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Circular_segment)
type CircularSegment
    implements IGeometry2D, IClosedShape, IConvexShape, IConnected, IArea, IBounded2D, ICentroid2D, IContainsPoint2D
{
    Circle: Circle;
    Sweep: AngleInterval;
}
```
